media.desc.to_mp4: MP4 H.264/AAC, plays everywhere (no re-encode when already H.264)
media.desc.to_webm: WebM with VP9 or AV1 video and Opus audio
media.desc.to_mkv: Matroska without re-encoding: every track is kept
media.desc.to_gif: Animated GIF with an optimized palette
media.desc.extract_flac: Save the audio as lossless FLAC
media.desc.extract_wav: Save the audio as uncompressed WAV
media.desc.compress_high: Almost no visible loss, original resolution
media.desc.target_size: Two-pass encode that fits a file size
media.desc.messaging: ≤ 720p MP4 under 16 MB, ready to send in chats
media.desc.crop: Keep only a region of the picture
media.desc.trim_video: Keep or remove a time range
media.desc.trim_audio: Keep or remove a time range (exact cut)
media.desc.mute: Remove the audio tracks without re-encoding
media.desc.rotate_meta: Change the orientation flag only: instant and lossless
media.desc.speed_video: Change the speed, audio pitch preserved
media.desc.speed_audio: Change the speed without changing the pitch
media.desc.fade_video: Fade in from black and out to black
media.desc.fade_audio: Fade the volume in and out
media.desc.extract_audio: Save every audio track without re-encoding
media.desc.frames: Export one image every few seconds into a folder
media.desc.contact_sheet: A grid of thumbnails with their times
media.desc.extract_subtitles: Save the embedded subtitles as SRT
media.desc.burn_sidecar: Burn the .srt with the same name into the picture
media.desc.burn_file: Burn a chosen subtitle file into the picture
media.desc.embed_subs: Add a subtitle file as a selectable track
media.desc.generate_subs: Create subtitles from speech with whisper.cpp
media.desc.split: Cut into clips of equal length, without re-encoding
media.desc.strip_metadata: Remove every tag, chapter, cover and GPS track
media.desc.to_m4a: M4A AAC, ideal for Apple devices
media.desc.to_opus: Opus: best quality at low bitrates
media.desc.remove_silence: Trim the silence at the beginning and at the end
media.desc.volume: Make it louder or quieter (limiter prevents clipping)
media.desc.transcribe_txt: Speech to plain text with whisper.cpp
media.desc.transcribe_srt: Speech to SRT subtitles with whisper.cpp
media.desc.transcribe_vtt: Speech to WebVTT subtitles with whisper.cpp
media.desc.visualize: Waveform video, ready for social networks
media.desc.tags: Title, artist, album, year, track, genre and cover
media.desc.extract_cover: Save the embedded cover art as an image
media.desc.join_video: One video from all the clips, in name order
media.desc.join_audio: One audio file from all the tracks, in name order
media.desc.playlist: M3U playlist with the selected tracks
media.desc.cover_video: MP4 with the image as a still picture over the audio
media.desc.all_to_mp3: Convert every audio and video file to MP3
media.prm.codec.help: H.264 plays everywhere, HEVC makes smaller files
media.prm.crf.help: Lower = better quality and bigger file (18–28)
media.prm.fast.help: Instant, but the start snaps to the nearest keyframe
media.prm.max_short.help: The short side is reduced to this value (never enlarged)
media.prm.subtitle: Subtitle file
media.prm.subtitle_embed.help: Empty = the .srt with the same name as the video
media.prm.model.help: Path of a ggml-*.bin file (empty = default)
media.prm.cover.help: JPG or PNG image to embed
